## Sync script checklist
<!-- Only for changes in syncScripts/. Test with two clients in one party, see docs/v1/guide/watch-party-workflow.md -->
- [ ] I raised the `version` in the script's `metadata.json`
- [ ] Tested with two clients (two browsers or profiles, different Discord accounts)
- [ ] Play, pause and seek reach the other client
- [ ] An episode or video change keeps both clients in the party and in sync
- [ ] Ads and buffering hold the party and release it afterwards
- [ ] Leaving and rejoining the party puts the client back in sync
- [ ] Tested with an account that has ads and one that doesn't (where the site has both)
